div.p: Run setup reads BAS and creates only what is missing: the item classes with their BAS stock and issue accounts, missing items, the BAS warehouses and showrooms, and a Stock Issue operation per warehouse. Safe to run again.
Load opening stock sets each item's quantity per warehouse to BAS's register at BAS unit cost. It posts no journal entry: the ledger already holds the 1206 balances.
Link purchases from BAS fills each item's purchase history from BAS's own purchase lines (din10): exact item and quantity per bill.

Rebuild movement history replays the year's BAS purchases and stock issues as dated receipts and issues, from a 1 January opening balance. Today's stock does not change and nothing is posted. Items whose BAS figures do not add up are listed, not replayed.

button.name: action_load_opening_stock
button.confirm: Replace the quantities of all stock items with BAS's register?

button.name: action_convert_purchase_entries
button.confirm: Replace this year's BAS purchases still booked as journal entries by vendor bills (same accounts and amounts)?

button.name: action_rebuild_movement_history
button.confirm: Replay this year's BAS purchases and issues as stock moves? Today's stock does not change.
